failure_summary.description: Calls omitted requested qualifiers or used incorrect fields, values, parameter buckets, or canonical forms.
Some calls used a related endpoint that did not directly provide the requested property or result.
Parameters were grouped into objects instead of serialized as separate name/value entries.
Malformed call-object syntax caused the complete response to fail parsing.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already addressed by existing skill guidance on endpoint eligibility, property and constraint mapping, schema-authoritative parameter placement and encoding, deduplication, and final JSON validation. Adding more rules would duplicate that guidance rather than patch a demonstrated gap.
